name: Titan Environmental Solutions Inc.
summary: Titan Environmental Solutions Inc., along with its affiliated companies, specializes in delivering comprehensive management services for non-hazardous solid waste and recyclable materials across the United States. The company's operations are structured into two primary segments: Trucking and Digester. Its core service offerings encompass the collection, hauling, intermediate processing (transfer), and final disposal of waste. This includes gathering discarded items from their point of origin and transporting them to facilities such as transfer stations, material recovery facilities (MRFs), or ultimate disposal sites. Moreover, Titan Environmental Solutions provides robust recycling services. These involve the meticulous separation of valuable, reusable materials from the general waste stream, their subsequent processing, and facilitating their sale to manufacturers for repurposing or remanufacturing. For food waste, the company delivers innovative processing solutions. These feature on-site digesters, seamlessly integrated with an Internet of Things (IoT) technology platform and cloud-based software. This sophisticated system provides comprehensive tracking, analytics, and actionable insights into waste generation and operational practices for both internal processes and across supply chains. Established in 2017, the company is headquartered in Bloomfield Hills, Michigan. It underwent a name change in January 2024, previously operating as TraQiQ, Inc.
